{{Quote|Did he bear any special grudge against the Trade Federation?''"<br />"''No more than anyone else in my home system.|[[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]]|<ref name="Cloak of Deception" />}}
The '''Mirial system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Illisurevimurasi sector/Legends|Illisurevimurasi sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mirial/Legends|Mirial]], [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialans]], and an [[Unidentified asteroid field (Mirial)|asteroid field]].
